text:
Maya Rivera: Quick sync: I'm drafting a compact Launch Gate checklist for the Optimize Toolkit (batching + KV cache recommendations + quant fallback logic + eval-driven alerts). Want the criteria to be unambiguous so Eng/Ops can sign off.
Ethan Brooks: perfect. paste the checklist when you have it, short bullets.
Maya Rivera: draft gates below — high level first: 
- Pilot hookup: 2 pilot customers integrated with the SDK and example config; end-to-end smoke passes.
- Latency SLOs (by context bucket): short (<=512 tokens) p95 < 220ms hosted; medium (513-2048) p95 < 380ms; long (>2048) p95 < 650ms. Dedicated SLAs can be negotiated but must be documented per-customer.
- Econ guardrail: 24h rolling median token-cost change <= 25% compared to customer baseline.
- Quality guard: Eval alert system must surface regressions with ≥0.75 TPR on OPTIMIZE_CANONICAL_V2 within a 24h window.
- Telemetry: batch_size distribution, cache_hit_rate (or per-shard proxy if global not available), quant_fallback_count, and per-request trace_id in logs.
- Safety fallback: automatic switch-to-conservative-config on critical eval alerts or if p99 latency > 700ms for 5 minutes.
Lina Xu: couple points: (1) For Dedicated, we should allow relaxed latency targets but require that devs declare expected seq-length mix in the pilot intake form. (2) Add requirement for per-request sampling (1%) of full token traces for 72h retention for debugging.
Ethan Brooks: agree to both. For (2) ensure exports are rate-limited and respect customer KMS/VPC rules.
Maya Rivera: noted — will add. Also adding severity buckets for eval alerts: warning = 0.06 drop, urgent = 0.12 drop (metric = normalized_concordance_v2).
Lina Xu: how about the detection window? if we use 24h we might miss sharp drops; propose dual windowing: 1h for spikes + 24h for trends.
Maya Rivera: good call. update: eval rules will evaluate both 1h spike detector and 24h trend detector. Sample alert rule snippet: 
```
alert_rule:
  type: eval_regression
  metric: normalized_concordance_v2
  windows: [1h, 24h]
  thresholds: {"1h": 0.10, "24h": 0.08}
  tpr_target: 0.75
```
Ethan Brooks: one more ask from customer side: FinLedger wants an explicit 'conservative_mode' toggle that pins batching=1, disables quant recommenders, and uses FP16 model. This must be togglable via API + console.
Maya Rivera: add to customer-driven gates: conservative_mode API + demo for both pilots. Also AcmeHealth requires VPC-only fallbacks (no data egress during fallback).
Lina Xu: for observability, note that our KV cache currently exposes per-shard stats only. We'll provide a computed global_cache_hit_estimate in the metrics pipeline as a stop-gap. Full global metric is an engineering task (~2 sprints). Mark it as "required but can be estimated".
Ethan Brooks: ops automation: can we wire conservative_mode to a feature flag so we can toggle and monitor effects per-customer? Need auto-rollback when eval urgent + fallback_count spike.
Lina Xu: feature flag exists; estimate 2 days to add SDK hooks + 1 day for console toggle + 1 day for monitoring.
Maya Rivera: blocking items list for launch: SDK example configs, eval pipeline wired to monitoring, feature-flag -> conservative_mode wired to console & SDK, sampling retention for traces, 2 pilot signups, acceptance checklist doc.
ops-bot: deployment event: optimize-toolkit/staging -> canary initiated at 1774623600 by @Maya Rivera.
Ethan Brooks: acceptance thresholds to include: no more than 12% of requests flagged as regressed by eval hooks in any 24h window during pilot; and median token-cost change per-customer <= 25% as Maya listed.
Maya Rivera: add explicit auto-rollback SLA: auto-rollback within 8 minutes of an urgent eval alert OR sustained fallback_count > baseline * 3 for 10 minutes. Manual rollback action must exist in console.
Lina Xu: add metric: quant_fallback_count_incident where we tag model transitions (q8->q4, q8->fp16, etc.) with reason codes. Also ops wants an alert when fallback_count_incident rate increases by 5x over baseline.
Ethan Brooks: QA note: we need an end-to-end test that simulates a quality regression and validates that eval alerts fire and rollback happens automatically in staging. Lina can you own the test plan?
Lina Xu: I can. I'll post the test plan by Tue (1774690000 ETA).
Maya Rivera: action owners & deadlines: 
- Maya: publish Launch Gate doc + checklist PR by EOD Thu (1774680000).
- Lina: test plan + metric implementation sketch by Tue (1774690000).
- Ethan: secure pilot PM commitments from AcmeHealth & FinLedger by next Fri.
- QA Runner: prepare automated regression + rollback test harness in staging within 5 working days.
Ethan Brooks: one minor ask: include an onboarding checklist for pilots that lists fields we need (seq length histogram, baseline token cost, KMS/VPC constraints, contact list).
Maya Rivera: will add pilot intake template to the PR. If no objections I'll convert this thread into the PR draft.
Ethan Brooks: no objections. :+1:
Lina Xu: looks good to me.
ops-bot: canary deployment succeeded at 1774623689.
Maya Rivera: thanks everyone — PR incoming. I'll tag owners and feature flags in the doc.
